title: Retrieval-augmented generation in biomedicine: a survey of technologies, datasets, and clinical applications
title_zh: 生物医学中的检索增强生成：技术、数据集与临床应用综述
abstract: Abstract Large language models (LLMs) in biomedicine face a fundamental conflict between static parameter knowledge and the dynamic nature of clinical evidence. Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) addresses this by grounding generation in external data, yet it introduces new complexities in latency and architecture. This survey synthesizes the biomedical RAG landscape from 2020 to 2025 through a structured literature mapping of 178 screened records, yielding 94 representative studies classified into naive RAG (38 studies, 40.4%), advanced RAG (46 studies, 48.9%), and modular RAG (10 studies, 10.7%). Beyond a technological taxonomy, we formalize the biomedical RAG trilemma, identifying the inherent trade-offs between reasoning depth, inference latency, and data privacy that constrain current clinical deployment. We analyze how recent agentic workflows enhance diagnostic reasoning but risk prohibitive latency, and how privacy constraints dictate the choice between powerful cloud-based models and local deployment. Finally, we outline the alignment gap in multimodal RAG and propose future directions for self-correcting, verifiable clinical agents.
abstract_zh: 摘要：在生物医学领域，大型语言模型（LLMs）面临静态参数知识与临床证据动态特性之间的根本冲突。检索增强生成（RAG）通过将生成过程根植于外部数据来解决这一问题，但也带来了延迟和架构方面的新复杂性。本综述通过对 2020 年至 2025 年间 178 条筛选记录的结构化文献映射，汇总了 94 项代表性研究，并将其分为基础 RAG（38 项，40.4%）、高级 RAG（46 项，48.9%）和模块化 RAG（10 项，10.7%）。除技术分类外，我们还正式提出了生物医学 RAG 的三难困境，识别了推理深度、推理延迟与数据隐私之间的内在权衡，限制了当前临床部署。我们分析了近期代理工作流如何提升诊断推理能力，但也可能导致不可接受的延迟，并讨论了隐私约束如何决定使用强大云端模型还是本地部署。最后，我们概述了多模态 RAG 的对齐差距，并提出了自我纠错、可验证临床代理的未来研究方向。
